استعطا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَعَطَا (istaʕaṭā) /is.ta.ʕa.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
# اُسْتُعِطَا (ustuʕiṭā) /us.tu.ʕi.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
# اِسْتَعِطَا (istaʕiṭā) /is.ta.ʕi.tˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعَطَ (istaʕaṭa)
